description: R08 DeserializationTests validation/lookup seam: safe Rust owns profile and action color-scheme validation, exact CascadiaSettings profile lookup over generated UUID identity, and ActionMap/keybinding required-parameter warning projection.

entries.notes: The validation aggregate records one UnknownColorScheme warning and resolves all three Microsoft profile vectors to Campbell for both dark and light appearance names.

Recursive action validation finds invalid setColorScheme references at top level, nested, and nested-in-nested depth and emits exactly one InvalidColorSchemeInCmd warning for each Microsoft settings vector.
ProfileLookup projects GetProfileByName and FindProfile over the exact existing UUIDv5 identity owner, including the generated UUID for ThisProfileShouldNotThrow and null lookup results.
Action validation reproduces the two invalid KeyMap entries, one valid splitPane ActionMap/NameMap entry, four ordered concrete warnings and the leading AtLeastOneKeybindingWarning aggregate.
Missing, empty and null wt commandline values each produce MissingRequiredParameter, remain invalid key-map bindings and surface beneath one AtLeastOneKeybindingWarning.
